newsitem.title: USA: Citicorp merges divisions, exec resigns - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Citicorp merges divisions, exec resigns - NYT.

text.p: Citicorp has merged the North American and European credit-card operations of its Citibank unit into its worldwide branch-banking business, and the head of the credit-card division has tendered her resignation, the New York Times reported in its Saturday editions.

Roberta Arena's departure at the end of the year will come after a series of resignations by top Citicorp executives during the past year, the newspaper said. Arena had been considered as a possible successor to Citicorp Chairman John Reed, it said.

The newspaper report, citing unnamed sources close to the executives, attributed Arena's planned departure to a difficult working relationship between her and William Campbell, the former president of Philip Morris Cos Inc's domestic tobacco operations who is now head of the branch-banking operations.
Citicorp was not immediately available to confirm the report or comment on it.
